workload: Frozen synthetic English HTML: 14 acquired documents/16 original queries plus 2 separately reported predeclared context-eligible paraphrase queries; no multilingual-support inference
policy: 128 all coherent windows, no top-K before dense; atomic 256 total-token eligibility; whole-query overflow fallback; equal-weight RRF k=60; 3/source; no score threshold
recommendation_basis: Small synthetic transient-document pilot; measured gains/costs and unsupported absent exposure below, not a representative benchmark. No retained-content vector storage justified by this volume/reuse alone. Separate user approval required. Separate predeclared context-eligible short paraphrase probes test candidate inclusion only, not hard ranking; their outcomes are separately reported, not pooled into frozen baseline counts. At 64/16 KiB both new arms have 9/14 successes versus frozen lexical/reranker 12/14. Case03 qualifying gold has zero eligible-window recall under256; remaining semantic recall hypothesis is inconclusive, not evidence of a model ranking failure. Atomic eligibility losses and added absent-answer exposure prevent adoption from this recipe; no clipping or threshold tuning was used. Observed vector volume and immediate synthetic reuse savings do not justify a persistent vector DB/archive; keep representations process-local only.
